object_description: compact sculptural four-story volume with a raised roof form
design_condition: The building is placed in the eastern half of the plot and withdrawn from the street, creating a spacious western schoolyard, framing the neighbouring gardens and forming a coherent space with the existing school building.

positive.statement: The clear urban planning skilfully uses the available space and creates well-usable outdoor areas.

position.rationale: The compact eastern mass leaves a clearly visible, spacious western schoolyard.

positive.statement: The compact structure creates a generous and naturally structured open space.

position.rationale: The dense four-story volume is clearly legible across plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The entrance square creates a good, clear connection to the existing school building.

position.rationale: The entrance connection is placed on the open western approach between building and existing school.

positive.statement: The arrangement of the classrooms is well thought out and offers good permeability between units for collaborative work.

position.rationale: Classroom permeability is internal, approximated within the upper-middle building volume.

positive.statement: The minimalist and abstract design language gives the project a pleasantly essential quality despite its size.

position.rationale: The restrained compact silhouette and raised roof form are directly visible in all projections.

positive.statement: The energy and building technology concept harmonizes well with the overall architectural concept.

position.rationale: Technology harmony is a conceptual performance judgment without a specific spatial referent.

negative.statement: The entrance, cloakroom and movement zone need further development, while the stairs must be separated as an escape route and a vestibule added.

position.rationale: Circulation spaces are internal and approximated near the western entrance side.

negative.statement: The outside space assigned to the classes is missing on the upper floors.

position.rationale: The upper-level constraint places missing class outdoor space high on the compact volume.

negative.statement: The structural protection of the existing trees may not be successful.

position.rationale: Trees are not distinguishable, so a low-confidence western plot-edge marker is used.

negative.statement: The complex and cost-intensive double-shell exposed-concrete construction should be examined for replacement.

position.rationale: Construction layers are not separable in the sample; the marker anchors the main envelope.

negative.statement: The project comes off worst in terms of system and construction costs.

position.rationale: Cost comparison is a whole-project judgment without a spatial referent.

negative.statement: The project is not convincing enough in its entirety despite an understandable concept and layout.

position.rationale: The criticism concerns the complete compact form and its overall arrangement.
